name: output-trim
description: Trims long Bash output to head, tail and failure lines; keeps the full output in a file.

outputDir.title: Output directory
outputDir.description: Where full outputs are kept. Empty: the plugin data directory.

maxLines.title: Line threshold
maxLines.description: Trim when the output has more lines than this.

maxBytes.title: Byte threshold
maxBytes.description: Trim when the output is larger than this many bytes.

maxMatches.title: Matching lines
maxMatches.description: At most this many FAIL/ERROR/panic/Traceback lines from the omitted middle.
